g1.label: 1. Home to Scotland's two largest ___
g1.why: The text says the Lowlands are home to Scotland's two largest cities.

g2.label: 2. Edinburgh is the ___
g2.why: The text says Edinburgh is the capital of Scotland.

g3.label: 3. Edinburgh Castle sits on an extinct ___
g3.why: The text says Edinburgh Castle sits on top of an extinct volcano.

g4.label: 4. The Fringe is the largest ___ festival
g4.why: The text says the Festival Fringe is the largest arts festival in the world.

g5.label: 5. Glasgow was once a great ___ city
g5.why: The text says Glasgow was once a great industrial city.

g6.label: 6. People from Glasgow are ___
g6.why: The text says people from Glasgow are known as Glaswegians.

g7.label: 7. Both cities are famous for their ___
g7.why: The text says both cities are famous for their excellent universities.

g8.label: 8. The two cities are the ___ of the trip
g8.why: The text says for many visitors the two cities are the highlight of the trip.

g1.label: 1. Edinburgh, ___ is the capital,...
g1.why: A non-defining relative clause about a place/thing uses ‘which’.

g2.label: 2. The people ___ live in Glasgow...
g2.why: A defining relative clause about people uses ‘who’.

g3.label: 3. Glasgow is a city ___ ships were built
g3.why: ‘Where’ introduces a defining relative clause about a place.

g4.label: 4. The castle, ___ sits on a volcano,...
g4.why: A non-defining relative clause about a thing uses ‘which’.

g5.label: 5. An author ___ books are read worldwide

g6.label: 6. The festival ___ takes place in August
g6.why: A defining relative clause about a thing uses ‘which’.

g7.label: 7. Visitors ___ come for the festival
g7.why: A defining relative clause about people uses ‘who’.

g8.label: 8. The university ___ she studied
g8.why: ‘Where’ introduces a relative clause about a place.

g1.label: 1. Edinburgh, ___ is the capital, is beautiful

g4.label: 4. The students ___ study here
g4.why: A defining relative clause about people uses ‘who’.

g5.why: ‘When’ introduces a relative clause about a time.

g6.why: A non-defining relative clause about a thing uses ‘which’.
